articles.summary: First BanCorp. (the “Corporation”) (NYSE: FBP), the bank holding company for FirstBank Puerto Rico, announced today that its Board of Directors approved the following capital actions: A new stock repurchase program of up to $350 million of the Corporation’s outstanding common stock that we expect to be executed, at management’s discretion, throughout 2027, subject to market conditions; this approval is in addition to the approximately $38.3 million remaining under the stock repurchase program announced on October 22, 2025; The declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on its outstanding common stock, which represents an increase of 25% compared to its most recent dividend paid in September 2026. The dividend is payable on December 11, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 27, 2026. articles.summary: First BanCorp. (the “Corporation” or “First BanCorp.”) (NYSE: FBP), the bank holding company for FirstBank Puerto Rico (“FirstBank” or “the Bank”), today reported a net income of $96.1 million, or $0.63 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $96.1 million, or $0.62 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2026, and $100.5 million, or $0.63 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025. Aurelio Alemán, President and Chief Executive Officer of First BanCorp, commented: “We delivered another quarter of strong core performance, highlighted by a return on average assets of 1.98%, a return on average equity of 19.5%, stable credit metrics, and healthy balance sheet trends against the backdrop of an increasingly volatile rate environment. These results demonstrate consistent execution against our strategic priorities, the resilience of our business model, and our commitment to soundness, profitability, and responsible growth.
